Clone properties
●
The clone inherits the position, costume, and graphical 
effects of the parent sprite.
●
The clone inherits all the scripts, but the "when green ﬂag 
clicked" event does not occur for the clone.
●
Events that occur before the creation of the clone do not 
affect it.
●
The parent sprite executes all the scripts except "when I start 
as a clone."
●
The sprite that creates clones is called a factory.
●
Unused clones should be deleted since the number of 
clones is limited.
